name: long_lb_sparsed_c1
long_context_execution: all arms: memory-linear GLOBAL causal / LOCAL sliding prefill via the 64-row kernel, elided O(n^2) prefill mask mapping, token-chunked MoE (V27_PREFILL_DENSE64=1); canvas calls follow each arm | decoding substrate piecewise_v1 (torch 2.12.1 grouped_mm MoE; decoder compiled reduce-overhead, split at GLOBAL attention which runs eager; LOCAL attention graphed unless the arm routes LOCAL layers; official-style compiled sampler); untimed per-arm warm-up before timed requests
selection_rule: Prior-work comparison (2026-09-30): labelled port of SparseD (ICLR 2026) on the same FA4 consumer and substrate, against B (observe once and hold, Fan M1 risk selection) and M3 R6 DP -ln2 (value-aware M1 risk, refreshed every 6 steps). SparseD at its documented long-context setting (select 30%, skip 20% = 10 of the 48-step cap) and with skip matched to B (1 step) at select 10/20/30%, so selection quality is compared at matched sparsity. Same 12+12 LongBench-v2 32K/64K panel items and seeds 101/202/303 as the sweep; two H100 hosts, every arm of a cell on one host; frozen before generation.
